title: Garden and Vow
author: Mirabel Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
